title: Beaver Funnel - Refuel Fast Without Spills
descriptionHtml:
You spill gasoline
every time.

You walk out to the garage. Lift the can. Hold the funnel with one hand. Pour. And then, spill on the mower, gasoline on your hand, the smell lingers for hours. Again.

It's not you who's clumsy. It's the equipment that's badly designed.


Snap on.
Pour. Done.

The Beaver Funnel snaps straight onto your fuel can. It stays in place while you pour, no extra hand needed. No wobbling. No spills. No cursing in the garage.

Three seconds to attach. One second to remove. Works with lawn mowers, chainsaws, trimmers, snow blowers, generators, the car and anything else you can refuel!

1 Snap the funnel onto the can → 2 Pour into the tank → 3 Clean refueling, zero spills


Built for the Swedish garage

Simple. Stable. Works right away.

Snap-on mount
Clicks onto the fuel can and stays stable throughout the entire fill-up.
Flexible spout
Bendable spout reaches into tight tank openings on lawn mowers and chainsaws.
Fits most cans
Compatible with standard openings on the most common fuel cans on the Swedish market.
Fuel-resistant plastic
Made of PP plastic that withstands long-term contact with gasoline, diesel and alkylate fuel.


14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
If the Beaver Funnel doesn't make refueling easier and cleaner, you return it and get your money back without hassle. We're convinced it solves the problem. That's why we can promise it.
